profile.summary: Under Armour is a global athletic performance brand that makes sportswear, footwear and accessories for athletes. It sells through its own stores, websites and wholesale partners. It has also partnered with Oakland schools and the Oakland Athletic League on school sports uniforms and coach training.

sources.title: Eat. Learn. Play., Under Armour and Curry Brand Unite to Revitalize Youth Sports in Oakland

review.notes: Organization is correct (Under Armour, Inc., Baltimore; its own story page documents the OUSD/Oakland Athletic League partnership). However the summary claims school sports uniforms and sales through own stores, websites and wholesale partners, and neither cited page says this (the Oakland page mentions gear and equipment support for middle school basketball and coach training only), so the summary is not supported by the cited sources. Contact fields (address, phone, email, website) are confirmed on the contact page.
